# Externally sourced input datasets

Do not commit third-party materials by default. Record their exact citation, origin, access URL, version, units, coordinate frame, and terms of use, then provide instructions to obtain them.

Inputs to document for the research release include:

1. Phobos irregular-shape OBJ model (Ernst v004 used by the final shape simulation).
2. Salamunićcar crater catalog, with exact source and selection rules.
3. Karachevtseva crater catalog, with exact source and selection rules.
4. Any dependencies/ephemeris used to create or check orbital geometry.

A derived/summarized CSV should not be mistaken for distribution permission of the original source catalog.
